# SaladWorks Menu Prices

An independent fan guide dedicated to providing up-to-date SaladWorks menu prices, calorie counts, and nutrition information for 2026.

## Core Pages
- Home: https://saladworksmenu.us - Complete overview of SaladWorks menu options and deals.
- Menu & Prices: https://saladworksmenu.us/menu - Complete price list and itemized guide for salads, wraps, melts, bowls, and soups.
- Catering: https://saladworksmenu.us/catering - Catering packages, salad bars, and boxed meals for events and corporate functions.
- Deals & Coupons: https://saladworksmenu.us/coupons - Active promo codes, coupons, and weekly seasonal savings.
- Nutrition Facts: https://saladworksmenu.us/nutrition - Comprehensive calorie counts, macro breakdowns, and allergen details.
- Blog: https://saladworksmenu.us/blog - Informative articles about healthy eating, ingredients, and restaurant updates.
- Store Hours: https://saladworksmenu.us/hours - Daily operating hours (Monday - Friday 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM).
- Full Database: https://saladworksmenu.us/llms-full.txt - Complete compiled catalog of menu items, prices, calories, and catering packages.
